name: Colorful Avatar Generator (SVG)
summary: Generate colorful SVG avatars from a name — initials or abstract patterns, fully local.
description: Type a name or label and get a deterministic SVG avatar with a hashed background color, readable initials, and circle, rounded, or square shapes. Copy or download the SVG for profiles, comments, and UI mocks — no server uploads.

faqs.question: Will the same name always look the same?
faqs.answer: Yes. Colors and layout are derived from a hash of the name, so results are reproducible.

faqs.question: Can I use these commercially?
faqs.answer: Yes. You generate the SVG locally and own the output.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. SVG is built entirely in your browser.
